description: AQR's trend research blends 1-, 3- and 12-month signals for faster reaction to turning points. Holds every futures ETF whose blended 1/3/12-month return is positive. Falsified if it lags the 12-month-only version on Sharpe ratio and drawdown.
title: Managed-futures trend · 1, 3 and 12-month blend · 23 futures ETFs (after Hurst, Ooi & Pedersen 2017, AQR)
